verdict.rationale: Pulumi ESC documents its own credential-issuing capability: it can act as an OIDC provider and issue short-lived, signed tokens for AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud. An agent could use these time-limited credentials. However, nothing in the evidence shows scoping or least-privilege controls, or credentials issued specifically for an agent. Missing for 10: scoped/least-privilege Pulumi Cloud API tokens, agent-specific credential issuance, documentation of permission scoping, independent or hands-on corroboration.
